details:
- CVE-2026-53793: path confinement bypass from an inner "/./" chroot module
  through an in-module symlink to a directory outside it, and through a ".."
  in the basis name a server sends to a pulling client
- CVE-2026-29518: symlink race and in-module symlink escape left in the path
  calls of a "use chroot = no" daemon other than the opens and the mkstemp
- CVE-2026-53784: module-root chdir guard moved onto the reworked change_dir()
- CVE-2026-53802: --files-from and filter merge files on a daemon read through
  a daemon-owned symlink that leaves the module
